text:
kevin: FYI canary in ap-southeast-1 failed during values merge. saw MountVolume error for payments/stripe-credentials :grimacing:
deploy-bot: canary failure: payments-service chart v2.4.1 -> post-upgrade hook failed: secret not found
maya: looks like the region sync lambda skipped ap-southeast for some reason. preflight passed but secret check returned 404
olivia: can we hotpatch the secret from vault and re-run canary? or should we rollback to v2.4.0?
kevin: rollback is messy — 2.4.1 included a lightweight migration (index build). product prefers not to rollback unless migrations fails in prod.
release-manager: holding all promotions to ap-* until we resolve. setting manual hold on deploy-bot.
ops: what are the recovery options we have now:
- create secret in-cluster from vault and re-run canary (fast)
- rollback region to v2.4.0 (safe if no migration applied)
- patch chart to accept literal fallback in values (requires testing)
maya: we have vault copy for ap region creds. ops, can you create secret and trigger a canary recheck?
ops: yes. running one-off. command I'm using:
```bash
VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal vault kv get -field=apiKey secret/payments/ap | \
  kubectl -n payments create secret generic stripe-credentials --from-literal=apiKey=$(cat -) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n payments rollout restart deploy/payments-service
```
ops: created secret and restarted deployment, pods are Pending -> Running. logs show secrets mounted.
kevin: triggering deploy-bot canary check now (will run health probes + hook checks).
deploy-bot: promotion paused by release-manager at 1749001301
deploy-bot: canary health: probes ok, post-upgrade hook completed, ap-southeast-1 promoted to v2.4.1 :white_check_mark:
release-manager: ok to resume other region promotions but keep a 20m stagger and monitor metric `hook_failure_rate` closely.
maya: adding release note: "ap-southeast manual secret sync during rollout" under Known Issues.
olivia: filing infra task to add explicit secret-exists preflight and alerting (GH #4582). Will include a toggle so we can opt-out for emergency rollouts.
ops: also pinning the edgezone pipeline to v2.4.1 for 24h to avoid mixed-version tenant exposure.
kevin: leaving a note for oncall: if canary fails with `secret not found`, prefer manual secret sync + recheck over rollback unless migration errors observed.
release-manager: follow-ups assigned: GH #4582 (preflight), #4583 (console alert), add release-note blurb, and update rollout checklist to include vault verification step. Closing hold and thread. :handshake:
